CommunityApplications.Profile: SeerrNG is a Seerr fork for requests across movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games. This repository provides a standalone SeerrNG Community Applications template and optional standalone NG fork templates for BookshelfNG, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG. LazyLibrarian, Mylar3, and Kapowarr are third-party apps available through their existing Community Applications listings; SeerrNG can connect to them without repackaging them. Install only the services you use.
